data.name: Dashboard reader
data.Description: The person who opens the local dashboard to read usage and list price cost. The code has no login or role check, so there is one human actor.

data.name: Cost state
data.Definition: How a session or request was priced: priced, free, unpriced or unavailable. Only priced figures enter cost totals. Defined at `web/src/api.ts:61`.

data.name: Provenance
data.Definition: Where a shown number came from: measured, derived, estimated, inferred or unavailable. Defined at `web/src/api.ts:63`.

data.name: Estimated rate
data.Definition: A price taken from a sibling model's rate row because the model has no row of its own, shown with an estimated marker. Help text at `web/src/pricing-notes.ts:4`.

data.name: Reported cost
data.Definition: The cost figure a coding tool wrote itself, shown beside the computed list price cost. Built at `web/src/pricing-notes.ts:48`.

data.name: Session outcome
data.Definition: A person's rating of a session: successful, partial, failed, abandoned or unrated. Defined at `web/src/api.ts:82`.

data.name: Unattributed turn
data.Definition: The row that holds spend outside any turn. It is left out of every turn ranking. Key defined at `web/src/turn-insights.ts:4`.

data.name: Sidechain
data.Definition: A subagent thread of a session. The query can exclude it with a flag at `web/src/api.ts:373`.

data.name: Unavailable is never shown as zero
data.Statement: When a log does not carry a value, the dashboard shows it as unavailable instead of a zero or a guess.

refs.quote: unavailable: 'the log does not carry it',
return 'This client logs no token counts, so cost is left blank instead of guessed.'

data.name: Unpriced cost stays out of totals
data.Statement: A session whose model matches no rate entry shows its tokens but its cost is kept out of totals.

refs.quote: return 'Tokens are counted, no rate entry matches this model, so cost stays out of totals.'

data.name: Reported cost divergence threshold
data.Statement: The tool's own cost is flagged as different when it differs from the computed cost by more than five percent or one cent, whichever is larger.

data.name: Rate age notice thresholds
data.Statement: A notice about old prices appears from 30 days and becomes a caution from 90 days. Unknown age shows nothing.

data.name: Cache price derivation
data.Statement: A cache price is the published figure when present, otherwise the input price times the provider ratio, otherwise it is not shown.

data.name: Rate row state
data.Statement: A rate row is free when its rules say free, priced when matched buckets carry spend, and unused otherwise.

data.name: Sub cent money keeps four decimals
data.Statement: A nonzero amount under one cent is shown with up to four decimals so it never reads as zero dollars.

data.name: Unattributed turn is excluded from rankings
data.Statement: Turn rankings and insights ignore the row for spend outside any turn.

data.name: Session table row limit
data.Statement: The sessions table shows at most 120 rows of the sorted list.

data.name: Outcome notes are saved only when changed
data.Statement: Notes and tags are sent to the server on blur only when the text differs from the saved value.

data.name: Automatic rescan every five minutes
data.Statement: While the tab is visible the dashboard asks the server to rescan logs every five minutes.

data.name: Read usage and cost for a period
data.Description: The Dashboard reader sees token usage and list price cost, filtered by date, client, model, project and cost state.
data.Postconditions: The overview, sessions, sources or pricing view shows the filtered slice.
Main flow: The page loads metadata and rates together. `web/src/App.tsx:168`
The report is fetched for the current query. `web/src/App.tsx:186`
The chosen view renders once its data is present. `web/src/App.tsx:333`
Alternative flows: At step 1, an unreachable server shows an offline card with a retry button. `web/src/api.ts:494`
Acceptance criteria: A value under one cent keeps four decimal places. `web/src/format.test.ts:27`

data.name: Inspect one session
data.Description: The Dashboard reader opens a session to see its summary, trace, economics and context.
data.Preconditions: A report with sessions is loaded.
data.Postconditions: The workspace shows the selected tab; trace, economics and context are fetched only once requested.
Main flow: The reader selects a session row. `web/src/App.tsx:287`
The workspace asks for the outcome at once. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:471`
A tab's data is fetched when that tab was requested. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:472`
Alternative flows: At step 3, a failed fetch shows the endpoint did not answer note with the error text. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:561`
Acceptance criteria: A trace breaks into turns by turn id. `web/src/TraceTab.test.ts:196`

data.name: Rate a session outcome
data.Description: The Dashboard reader marks a session successful, partial, failed, abandoned or unrated and adds notes and tags.
data.Postconditions: The server holds the outcome, notes and tags.
Main flow: The reader picks an outcome label. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:312`
The page sends it with PUT. `web/src/api.ts:577`
Alternative flows: At step 2, a failed save shows the error text in the status line. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:287`
Acceptance criteria: Notes and tags are not resent when unchanged. `web/src/SessionWorkspace.tsx:292`

data.name: Check list prices
data.Description: The Dashboard reader reviews the rate table, which rates are used, and which models were priced from a sibling rate.
data.Preconditions: The rate table and report are loaded.
data.Postconditions: The pricing view shows one row per rate with its state and spend.
Main flow: The reader opens the pricing view. `web/src/App.tsx:337`
Each rate row gets a state from its rules and spend. `web/src/Pricing.tsx:128`
Alternative flows: At step 2, a model with only a prefix match is listed separately under its parent rate. `web/src/Pricing.tsx:106`
Acceptance criteria: An estimated bucket is not credited to the parent. `web/src/Pricing.test.ts:127`
